titleEn: Minimum Possible Integer After at Most K Adjacent Swaps On Digits
title: 最多 K 次交换相邻数位后得到的最小整数
summary: 最多交换相邻数字 k 次，求可得到的字典序最小数字字符串。
insight: 从答案高位开始贪心尝试数字零到九的最早未使用位置。树状数组维护仍在序列中的位置数，该位置前剩余元素数就是移到当前输出位的交换成本。
pitfalls: 相同数字始终使用最早位置最省成本
已取走位置会减少后续移动成本

solutions.title: 数字位置队列与树状数组贪心
solutions.idea: 快速计算每个候选数位移动到当前前端的成本。
steps: 为 0..9 建原下标队列，Fenwick 初始每个位置为一
每个输出位从 digit=0..9 尝试队首 position，cost=query(position)-1
首个 cost<=k 的数字加入答案，扣成本、弹队首并在 Fenwick 删除该位置

code.java: class Solution { private static class Fenwick{int[] tree;Fenwick(int n){tree=new int[n+1];}void add(int index,int delta){for(int i=index+1;i<tree.length;i+=i&-i)tree[i]+=delta;}int query(int index){int sum=0;for(int i=index+1;i>0;i-=i&-i)sum+=tree[i];return sum;}}public String minInteger(String num,int k){Deque<Integer>[] positions=new Deque[10];for(int digit=0;digit<10;digit++)positions[digit]=new ArrayDeque<>();Fenwick fenwick=new Fenwick(num.length());for(int i=0;i<num.length();i++){positions[num.charAt(i)-'0'].addLast(i);fenwick.add(i,1);}StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int output=0;output<num.length();output++)for(int digit=0;digit<10;digit++)if(!positions[digit].isEmpty()){int position=positions[digit].peekFirst(),cost=fenwick.query(position)-1;if(cost<=k){k-=cost;answer.append(digit);positions[digit].removeFirst();fenwick.add(position,-1);break;}}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private class Fenwick(n:Int){val tree=IntArray(n+1);fun add(index:Int,delta:Int){var i=index+1;while(i<tree.size){tree[i]+=delta;i+=i and -i}};fun query(index:Int):Int{var i=index+1;var sum=0;while(i>0){sum+=tree[i];i-=i and -i};return sum}};fun minInteger(num:String,kValue:Int):String{val positions=Array(10){java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>()};val fenwick=Fenwick(num.length);for(i in num.indices){positions[num[i]-'0'].addLast(i);fenwick.add(i,1)};var k=kValue;val answer=StringBuilder();repeat(num.length){for(digit in 0..9)if(positions[digit].isNotEmpty()){val position=positions[digit].peekFirst();val cost=fenwick.query(position)-1;if(cost<=k){k-=cost;answer.append(digit);positions[digit].removeFirst();fenwick.add(position,-1);break}}};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { struct Fenwick{vector<int> tree;Fenwick(int n):tree(n+1){}void add(int index,int delta){for(int i=index+1;i<(int)tree.size();i+=i&-i)tree[i]+=delta;}int query(int index){int sum=0;for(int i=index+1;i;i-=i&-i)sum+=tree[i];return sum;}};public:string minInteger(string num,int k){array<queue<int>,10> positions;Fenwick fenwick(num.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)num.size();++i){positions[num[i]-'0'].push(i);fenwick.add(i,1);}string answer;for(int output=0;output<(int)num.size();++output)for(int digit=0;digit<10;++digit)if(!positions[digit].empty()){int position=positions[digit].front(),cost=fenwick.query(position)-1;if(cost<=k){k-=cost;answer+=char('0'+digit);positions[digit].pop();fenwick.add(position,-1);break;}}return answer;} };
